name: Snow Report 2026-10-26 09:00:00
report:
If you like peace and quiet, now is the best time to visit Snowbird. Though Summer Activities and the Scenic Tram are closed for the season, the hiking and biking trails remain open, and the views are always serving.

The Scenic Tram is scheduled to reopen in winter. Speaking of winter, save the date. Opening Day is scheduled for November 27, conditions dependent.

Season Passholders, don't forget to use your FREE night at The Cliff Lodge, valid until December 17. 

The Blister Summit is returning to Snowbird April 6-10. If you love gear, this event is for you. Test next year's skis, boards and outerwear, hear from the best in the biz, and attend evening events including panels and après. Register by October 31 to lock in the best price.

Still want some mountain time? The Cliff Spa is open, so you can treat yourself to a relaxing massage before taking a dip in the rooftop pool. Many of Snowbird's restaurants are also operating throughout the week. Enjoy a decadent steak at the Steak Pit or enjoy the view from the 10th floor of The Cliff Lodge at The Aerie.

Can't wait to see you up here!

name: Snow Report 2026-10-11 13:00:00
report:
Oktoberfest Update:

Due to high winds, the final day of Oktoberfest, Sunday, October 11, will run with limited operations.


The sun is out, the fall colors are happening and the views in Little Cottonwood are B-E-A-utiful. It's time to "take a hike" (in the nicest way possible). Want to elevate your time here? Take the Scenic Tram. It's only open until Sunday before it shuts down for seasonal maintenance. 

On tap is the final weekend of Oktoberfest. Just 2 days left to get your fill of brats, beer, polka and pretzels. Enjoy the classics like Halle Entertainment and Alphorns on Hidden Peak. Then, check out this week's artists, musicians and more. Wasatch Adaptive Sports is the featured non-profit. They are also hosting the live artist who will be painting a set of wings. 

Note: Herban Empire and Queen Dilla, who were playing on the Chickadee Stage, will now be playing in The Tram Club.

Summer Activities operate Saturday and Sunday, 11 am to 6 pm, while the Aerial Tram remains open daily, 11 am to 6:30 pm. It's the final weekend of the summer for both Summer Activities and the Tram. 

 

Fall Operations Schedule-Summer Activities

  • Beginning October 1: Open Saturday-Sunday, 11 am - 6 pm
  • October 11: Last day of the season for Summer Activities

Fall Operations Schedule-Scenic Tram

  • Beginning October 5: 11 am - 6:30 pm, daily
  • October 11: Last day of the season for Scenic Tram Rides

 

Can't wait to see you up here.
